";
const storeDiffB64 = "";

function inflateB64(b64) {
  return inflateSync(Buffer.from(b64, "base64"));
}

writeFileSync(join(root, "src/lib/trench/logic.ts"), inflateB64(logicB64));
console.log("wrote logic.ts");

for (const f of ["logic-core.ts", "logic-tail.ts", ".profit-loop-marker"]) {

}

const diffPath = join(root, "store.profit-loop.diff");
writeFileSync(diffPath, inflateB64(storeDiffB64));
execFileSync("patch", ["-p1", "--forward", "--batch", "-i", "store.profit-loop.diff"], {

  stdio: "inherit",
});
